name: Manbiki, Dame. Zettai!! ~Seiso na Manbiki Joshi - Class Zen'in 2-hon Sashi! Double ω Keikaku~
original_name: 万引き、ダメ。絶対!! ～清楚な万引き女子・クラス全員2本挿し！ダブルω計画～
source:
Akio works at a convenience store. Yukio, his younger brother, always comes to his store after work. He is actually a teacher at a girls school. What they do is to punish girls who committed shoplifting.

One day, Yumi comes to the store and looks for a toilet. Yukio takes her to the toilet and secretly puts an article for sale into her bag. When she comes out, Akio stops her and checks her bag...

[From Erogeshop]
